<thought>Using the most intense peak (m/z 182.073) as the [M+H]⁺ ion, the neutral monoisotopic mass is ≈181.066 Da. A formula that matches this mass within typical MS error is C₉H₁₁NO₃ (exact mass 181.0739 Da, within ~8 mDa). This fits the observed mass and gives an integer double‑bond equivalent, so it is the most plausible molecular formula.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H11NO3</final_answer>
